owner_impact: A fresh research-AI session now starts from formal Virtual Lab truth rather than automatic scientific workspace/history. Neutral read_workspace discovery returns the full current authoring/runtime contract plus the global canonical capability registry. Experiment discovery remains available only when explicitly requested, and explicit Experiment reads still obey existing RLS. Historical Grok request reasoning, Professor/developer notes, Experiment descriptions and other prior scientific discourse are not part of neutral discovery.

next.text: #335 is the known successor. It will audit the exact deployed MCP from a fresh-session viewpoint and record exactly what scientific and capability information a new research AI can see. #335 has not started in this owner turn.

technical_evidence: MCP interface 11 makes neutral no-ID discovery explicit; capability-request interface vlab.capability-request/3 is unchanged.
Global authenticated canonical capability reads use a narrow SECURITY DEFINER RPC returning only canonical identity/definition/lifecycle/implementation fields and minimal publication provenance.
Default neutral discovery returns before any Experiment/collection query; include_workspace_index=true is required for RLS-governed workspace listing.
Explicit Experiment reads continue through the existing authenticated RLS client and retain complete selected workspace content.
Regression tests cover the neutral boundary, global capability memory, explicit workspace opt-in, historical-field exclusion and interface versioning.
